decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models that is tightly tied to the core assortment and the firm's stated direction, management is very likely to continue backing it and interpret any weaker signals as temporary.
This premium salami snack line remains close to existing capabilities and has accumulated line-level merchandising and launch commitment, which makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Although newer and narrower than the bigger lines, this organic boiled sausage fits the established business and recent launch effort gives management reason to keep it on the market for longer.

Because this organic chicken-breast range has several models and matches the firm's expansion into organic assortments and new formats, management is likely to stay committed absent clear failure evidence.
